purpose: Fixar direcao de movimento, timing, spacing, pivot e carisma da TAINA antes de qualquer key pose, strip ou promocao para res/.

global_motion_rules.root_foot_policy: grounded actions keep one root foot locked until recovery declares transfer
global_motion_rules.center_of_mass_policy: weight shifts are deliberate and bounded; no snap to idle
global_motion_rules.face_policy: idle focused; attacks tense jaw/eyes; hurt asymmetric pain
global_motion_rules.fx_policy: hit sparks, water push and palette flash are separate runtime assets; never baked into character body sheet
global_motion_rules.palette_flash_policy: runtime/CRAM or separate FX only after palette_domain_report; no accidental requantized flash
global_motion_rules.shading_motion_policy: future highlights and shadows must follow torso, hip and limb rotation; no pasted static lighting

action_contracts.gameplay_role: neutral close-combat readability and personality loop
action_contracts.motion_archetype: held guard with small breathing and delayed cloth
action_contracts.root_foot_policy: both feet remain grounded; no pivot drift
action_contracts.secondary_motion: sash and hair move after shoulder/chest breath, amplitude <= 1px internal line shift at lineart stage
action_contracts.acceptance_notes: must not become a static doll; must not move feet or resize head

action_contracts.gameplay_role: fast close-range punish, safe only if timed
action_contracts.root_foot_policy: rear foot locks through active frame; front foot may advance by 1_to_2px only if ground_y remains stable
action_contracts.impact_readability: extended glove/hand wrap, shoulder twist, eyes toward opponent
action_contracts.secondary_motion: sash trails forward on frames 4-5; hair follows torso rotation late
action_contracts.acceptance_notes: attack cannot begin directly on active frame; recovery must be visible

action_contracts.root_foot_policy: support foot locks through active frame; striking leg returns before idle
action_contracts.impact_readability: clear knee/leg silhouette and torso counter-rotation, not a generic karate kick
action_contracts.secondary_motion: pants mass and sash lag behind hip by 1_to_2 frames
action_contracts.acceptance_notes: state must communicate BJJ/muay-thai brawler fantasy, not generic martial pose

action_contracts.root_foot_policy: rear foot anchors while both hands push; front foot may slide only with declared dust/water FX separate
action_contracts.impact_readability: both palms and forward torso drive must read before water FX is added
action_contracts.secondary_motion: hair/sash overshoot on frames 6-7, then settle
action_contracts.acceptance_notes: water/tide shape is separate FX; body strip must stay clean of baked splash

action_contracts.gameplay_role: damage direction and temporary loss of control
action_contracts.root_foot_policy: light hurt preserves one foot contact; heavy hurt must branch to knockdown_getup contract
action_contracts.impact_readability: asymmetric pain face, shoulder collapse and force direction clear
action_contracts.secondary_motion: hair and sash continue in force direction after torso impact
action_contracts.acceptance_notes: scale and ground_y cannot drift; hurt face cannot equal idle face

idle_breathing_cycle_contract.reason: TAINA is a hero/fighter with readable torso and guard in idle.

facial_expression_phase_map.reason: Face/eyes are identity hooks in the approved model sheet and must change for attack/hurt.

cloth_secondary_animation_contract.reason: Curly hair, wraps and sash are must-preserve identity hooks and motion cues.

hand_pose_keyframe_contract.reason: Gloves/wraps sell guard, jab, block and Empurrao de Mare.

pass_fail.reason: This is the required pre-generation direction contract. It intentionally does not claim visual animation evidence.

next_required_route: draw v06 lineart with pivot_and_scale_contract visible-height correction
produce first idle_guard and light_jab_cross key poses as lineart only
emit contact_sheet, pivot_overlay, foot_contact_report and frame_delta_report from real frames
